study_scope: Declared synthetic structural study, not independently calibrated operational data or a held-out application.
paired_cases: All 24 immutable R48 cases, identical model, catalog, charges, promise and budget. Historical R48 values and times remain identified as historical; they are not fresh matched-machine timings.

additional_common_eligibility.weights: independent integers 1..5 from the specified seed, normalized exactly
additional_common_eligibility.charges: independent integers 0..6 divided by 100 from the specified seed

eligibility_stress.ceilings: min(1, cap + an integer 0..5 divided by 10)
eligibility_stress.promise: aggregate cap times an integer 1..10 divided by 10
eligibility_stress.exact_reference: all books of size at most 3

independent_mip.cases: paired case-00 through case-11 plus all six eligibility-stress instances
independent_mip.record: status, wall time, node count, solver gap, envelope error and numerical bracket, including every time limit

reporting: Retain every specified case. Record exact rational lower/upper bounds, unresolved intervals, original-space policy, complete cover, pooling primal-dual witnesses, independent check time, certificate hash and measured toolchain. Freeze this protocol before the study run; test-only examples are separate.
